summary: @servicetitan/ld-type-generator preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundle
details: On npm install, the package's preinstall hook runs setup.mjs, which downloads a Bun runtime binary from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, marks it executable, and invokes it against a bundled ~727KB obfuscated file math_init.js. math_init.js begins with `// @bun @bun-cjs` and uses rotated string-array obfuscation (WV8StW shuffle over an n7gIxM constant array with fromCodePoint reconstruction) that hides all strings, URLs, and API calls until executed under Bun. setup.mjs itself uses hex-mangled identifiers and inline string dictionaries to obscure control flow. The package's advertised purpose is a small CLI that queries LaunchDarkly's REST API to emit a TypeScript declaration file (main=dist/cli.js, engines Node >=18, deps axios/meow/lodash); math_init.js is not referenced from dist/cli.js and the declared workload does not require the Bun runtime. The install-time surface — fetching an alternate runtime and executing an opaque obfuscated bundle on the installer's machine before any user code runs — is unrelated to the documented functionality and matches the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern used to evade Node-focused scanning.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
